title: 초승달 빙결로
detail: An asymmetric crescent-shaped frost forge. ONE thick C-shaped dark stone and metal cradle curves around a large low floating opaque pale-blue ice sphere, leaving a very clear open wedge on one side. The crescent is low enough that the entire blue sphere and the C-shaped gap are visible from above. Three broad rectangular bronze bands secure the crescent. A short pointed icy nozzle is integrated into one end of the C, the other end blunt; one compact offset foot beneath the crescent. Bold asymmetrical C-and-circle silhouette, primitive substantial forms. No orbiting rings, no vertical supports covering the sphere, no elaborate ornament.
